gaps.why: No information on system access, credential management, or access handover procedures for systems, databases, or cloud.
Explicitly stated as missing in the document. No details on build, deploy, rollback, monitoring, or operational procedures.
No clear list of regular duties, maintenance, reporting, or compliance tasks. The 'Business Logic Caveats' are more constraints than recurring tasks.
No links or references to code repositories, design documents, API specs, or other relevant internal documentation (e.g., Confluence).

coverage.notes: High-level system architecture, service components, communication patterns (REST, Kafka), data storage (PostgreSQL, Redis), and core logic (orchestrator, idempotency) are well described.
Specific JIRA tickets (PAY-1423, PAY-1451, PAY-1460) and their current status/impact are listed.
Product PM, client integration team, and PagerDuty rotation mentioned.
PAY-1423 (known issue), PAY-1451 (tech debt/improvement), and operational caveats are mentioned.

suggested_additions: Section on how to obtain access (e.g., JIRA tickets, permissions matrix, vault locations) for all critical systems (DBs, AWS, internal tools).
Detailed runbooks for building, deploying (CI/CD pipelines), rolling back, monitoring (dashboard links, alert explanations), and common troubleshooting steps for each service.
List of recurring tasks, such as specific reports, compliance checks, or maintenance jobs, with frequency and ownership.
Links to all relevant code repositories, key design documents, API documentation, and any internal wiki pages (e.g., Confluence).
